supporting_observations.claim: During the alerted period, WS-NKIM-01 had multiple connections to the explicit proxy at 10.53.20.30:8080, with several spaced by roughly five minutes; the sequence also includes shorter gaps, so it is not consistently five-minute periodic.
The supplied records for those sessions identify the proxy connection and byte counts, but do not identify the tunneled HTTPS destination or the originating workstation process.

known_telemetry_limitations: WinSec and Sysmon collection for WS-NKIM-01 was unavailable from 13:25 to 14:15 UTC due to a log collection outage.
Proxy collection was unavailable from 13:25 to 14:15 UTC due to a log collection outage.
Zeek connection and DNS sensors are reported as available, but the supplied records do not include TLS/SNI details that would identify the destinations of the alerted sessions.
claims_not_established: Whether the tunneled destinations were approved services such as CaseBinder or unapproved services.
Which process on WS-NKIM-01 initiated the alerted sessions.
Whether the repeated traffic transferred data of security significance or was routine application activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover proxy logs or upstream proxy records for 13:30–14:10 UTC, including CONNECT targets, usernames, user agents, and tunnel byte counts.
Recover endpoint process/network telemetry for WS-NKIM-01 during the collection outage and correlate process IDs with the proxy sessions.
Obtain TLS/SNI or equivalent destination metadata for the sessions and compare it with approved service destinations and application update behavior.
